original_value: AbstractAssay of Transposase-Accessible Chromatin by deep sequencing (ATAC-seq) has been widely used to profile the chromatin accessibility genome-wide. For the absence of an integrated scheme for deep data mining of specific biological issues, here we present ATAC-pipe, an efficient pipeline for general analysis of chromatin accessibility data obtained from ATAC-seq experiments. ATAC-pipe captures information includes not only the quality of original data and genome-wide chromatin accessibility but also signatures of significant differential peaks, transcription factor (TF) occupancy and nucleosome positions around regulatory sites. In addition, ATAC-pipe automatically converts statistic results into intuitive plots at publication quality, such as the read length distribution, heatmaps of sample clustering and cell-type-specific regulatory elements, enriched TF occupancy with motifs footprints and TF-driven regulatory networks. ATAC-pipe provides convenient workflow for researchers to study chromatin accessibility and gene regulation.Availability https://github.com/QuKunLab/ATAC-pipe

result.paraphrase: Abstract Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using deep sequencing (ATAC-seq) is widely used to profile genome-wide chromatin accessibility. To address the lack of an integrated framework for deep data mining of specific biological questions, we introduce ATAC-pipe, an efficient pipeline for general analysis of chromatin accessibility data from ATAC-seq experiments. It captures not only the quality of the raw data and genome-wide chromatin accessibility, but also signatures of significant differential peaks, transcription factor (TF) occupancy, and nucleosome positions around regulatory sites. In addition, ATAC-pipe automatically turns statistical results into publication-quality, intuitive plots, including read length distributions, heatmaps of sample clustering and cell-type-specific regulatory elements, enriched TF occupancy with motif footprints, and TF-driven regulatory networks. ATAC-pipe offers researchers a convenient workflow for studying chromatin accessibility and gene regulation. Availability: https://github.com/QuKunLab/ATAC-pipe
